🏈 Squad Evaluation (Vader's Raiders) [+ Click to expand definitions]

Squad Verdict Guidance & Master Definitions:
  • ⚠️ SHORT-TERM VOLUME (IR Replacement): Temporary starter workload due to an injury/IR ahead on depth chart. High short-term usage, but expected to drop when starter returns.
  • 🚨 AIR YARD BUY-LOW: High downfield target volume (≥65 Unrealized Air Yds/gm) but low PPR points (<11.0). Massive regression breakout candidate.
  • 🔥 CORE STARTER: Elite positional workload (Opp ≥ 0.45) matched with high PPR production (PPR ≥ 13.0). Unquestioned weekly start.
  • 🚨 BUY LOW HOLD: High opportunity (Opp ≥ 0.40) and minimum target volume but low output (PPR < 11.0). Do not drop.
  • 📈 SURGING ROLE: Workload velocity growing rapidly (Surge ≥ 0.100). Bench player earning a larger share of offensive plays.
  • ⚠️ FLUKE RISK (Trade Out): Scoring fantasy points on weak volume (<8 touches/gm & Opp < 0.22). Sell high before regression.
  • ✂️ DROP CANDIDATE: Weak volume (Opp < 0.20) and poor fantasy output (PPR < 8.0). Safely drop to free up bench space.
  • 👀 HOLD: Stable positional role without immediate breakout or drop signals.

🔥 Unclaimed Waiver Wire (Ranked by Opportunity Surge) [+ Click to expand definitions]

Waiver Verdict Guidance & Master Definitions:
  • ⚠️ SHORT-TERM VOLUME (IR Replacement): Temporary starter workload due to an injury ahead on the depth chart. Ideal short-term rent-a-player.
  • 🚨 AIR YARD BUY-LOW: Unowned receiver seeing major deep targets (≥65 Unrealized Air Yds/gm) with low PPR output. Priority stash.
  • 🚨 BUY LOW / TARGET: High opportunity (Opp ≥ 0.45) & target floor with weak fantasy points (PPR < 10.0). Priority target.
  • 🔥 HIGH-VOLUME ALPHA: Unowned player producing elite volume (Opp ≥ 0.45) and strong PPR points (PPR ≥ 13.0). Priority pickup.
  • 📈 SURGING WORKLOAD: Workload velocity jumping rapidly over the past 3 weeks (Surge ≥ 0.100).
  • ⚠️ SELL HIGH / FLUKE: Points scored without underlying volume (<8 touches/gm). High risk for waiver spending.
  • 👀 STASH: Low volume/points currently, but worth monitoring for deep bench storage.

🎯 Rival Roster Trade Targets (High Opportunity / Low Output) [+ Click to expand definitions]

Trade Verdict Guidance & Master Definitions:
  • ⚠️ SHORT-TERM VOLUME (IR Replacement): Backup producing temporarily; sell high before primary starter returns.
  • 🚨 AIR YARD BUY-LOW: Target receivers with massive downfield volume (≥65 Unrealized Air Yds/gm) underperforming on points.
  • 🚨 BUY LOW / TRADE TARGET: Player rostered by a rival manager with significant workload (Opp ≥ 0.40) underperforming on points (PPR < 11.0).

🛠️ Core Features & Mathematical Formulas

Active Features & Analytics Engine Breakdown:
  • 📊 Position-Weighted Opportunity Score (WOPR / Workload Share)
    Blends target share, air yards share, rushing share, and passing attempts tailored per position:
    • WR / TE Opportunity (WOPR): 1.5 × Target Share + 0.7 × Air Yards Share
    • RB Opportunity Share: Rushing Share + 1.5 × Target Share
    • QB Opportunity Share: (Passing Attempts + Rushing Carries) / 50.0
  • 🔄 Trade Analyzer Tool
    A dynamic mini-modal calculator that evaluates 1-for-1, 2-for-1, or 2-for-2 trade proposals between rostered assets across rival managers. Filter assets by rival team/manager to compute net changes in Opportunity Score and PPR Average.
  • 🎯 Unrealized Air Yards
    Tracks downfield target volume (Air Yards − Completed Air Yards). Automatically flags positive regression candidates underperforming on points with 🚨 AIR YARD BUY-LOW.
  • 🗓️ Trailing 3-Week Heuristic Window
    Uses DuckDB window functions over a player's last 3 active games to eliminate single-week skewed averages and reflect true current usage trends.
  • 📈 Workload Velocity (Surge)
    Calculates multi-week acceleration in role usage to highlight rising bench assets before point production catches up.
  • 📉 Interactive PPR Sparklines
    Visualizes recent 4-game scoring trajectories inline within master tables. Hovering over sparklines reveals raw game-by-game PPR scores.
  • 🛡️ Depth Chart & IR Volume Guardrail
    Tracks team depth order and injury reports. Automatically tags backup players stepping into starter roles with ⚠️ SHORT-TERM VOLUME (IR Replacement) to prevent false trade/breakout signals.
  • 🌦️ Defensive Strength of Schedule & Weather Cheat Sheet
    Evaluates upcoming 3-week opponent matchups color-coded by defensive points allowed per position, along with high-wind (💨), extreme cold (🥶), and severe heat (🔥) outdoor flags restricted to next week's game.
